title: First Day
purpose: Gold-standard introductory mission: teach business orientation, investigation discipline and professional uncertainty before procurement vocabulary.
distractors: The preferred supplier is Helix Components.
The PR quantity is 24 while immediate Line 3 demand is 18.
The system delivery date says Thursday but confirmation is missing.
decision_changing_unknown: Whether PO-77104 for 20 connectors is actually confirmed to arrive before Friday production.
strong_preliminary_position: Do not commit to a new purchase yet. Confirm the inbound PO, then compare confirmed incoming quantity plus usable stock against production demand and timing.

consequence_model.premature_buy: Potential duplicate supply, excess inventory and unnecessary spend.
consequence_model.blame_requester: Operational risk remains unresolved and cross-functional trust deteriorates.
consequence_model.escalate_without_investigation: Mentor returns the case and expects the learner to exhaust available evidence first.
consequence_model.professional_uncertainty: Investigation continues with a precise information request; no premature commitment is made.
